_comment: A pinned, unmodified copy of Microsoft's Sentinel analytics rule 'New access credential added to Application or Service Principal', which Learn's 'Microsoft Entra security operations guide for applications' links as the pre-built alert for credentials added to existing applications. Never edit these files: update the snapshot by copying a newer upstream commit and regenerating this manifest in a reviewed pull request. scripts/tests/test_third_party_snapshots.py fails when a file stops matching its hash.
name: Microsoft Sentinel rule: New access credential added to Application or Service Principal
license: MIT (LICENSE, copied from the repository root).
learn_link_note: Learn links the rule's earlier path, Detections/AuditLogs/NewAppOrServicePrincipalCredential.yaml, which upstream now keeps as a stub whose description points to this path.
not_copied: The stub at Detections/AuditLogs/NewAppOrServicePrincipalCredential.yaml that Learn links, which holds only a pointer to this path.
The rest of the Microsoft Entra ID solution and everything else in Azure/Azure-Sentinel.
